snippet.title: Quantum Resonance - Trailer
snippet.description:
Are you ready to survive the nightmare?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3666200/Quantum_Resonance/

You play as Frank, a maintenance engineer in charge of a quantum physics underground laboratory. When an experiment goes horribly wrong, you'll have to use stealth and think fast to escape what has now become an underground prison.
